verdict.rationale: Angular's docs state it is a fully featured platform where first-party modules for forms, routing, and more work together, and a community comment confirms @angular/router as the official router, which improved on AngularJS routing. An older community report noted early Angular 2 router gaps (passing data to child routes, reading route segments, checking active routes); this reflects an early version rather than a contradiction of the first-party integrated router. missing for 10: in-depth first-party router documentation (route configuration, guards, lazy loading), current independent hands-on corroboration of seamless integration, evidence those early limitations were resolved.
